tags.feature: Made a big decision: expanded field of view, now Ran have broader perspective
Added 10 new map decorations 🌿
UI adjustments for upgrade options to accommodate new weapons and refit
ScarletFoX-890: A mid-to-close-range shotgun with quad-shot trajectory, a balanced performance piece in the Northland Fire series.
"Carrot": A mid-range light submachine gun with wide spread. Let your enemies eat carrots! (Why carrot?)

Pick Up GGhen: No one knows if someone sprinting while holding a hen is a good idea, but it happened. The hen will unleash a powerful Cluck! Everyone will revere those who charge into battle while holding a hen!
Shark ruler: A magical boomerang made of black steel, capable of altering its trajectory with telepathy to clear obstacles. "-The reliable buddy always return."
Twall:The higher Nwall looks a bit reassuring.
S-S-R:Spines-Shell-Rat! Yes,ssrat comes to help you.Hard shell protects them taking only 1 damage at a time, stabbing all the enemies trying who to pass 2 times.
Unsuspicious Grass pile: The unsuspicious grassy pile has been summoned.Firstly, it is not suspicious at all, secondly, It definitely doesn't look like a trap.
Modified and added some monster enhancement options
Enhanced Ran's magic reservoir
When you creating monsters, angels may grant weapons
ScarletFoX-890: Add 3 new refit
"Carrot":Add 5 new refit
Shark ruler:Add 2 new refit
Performance optimization reduces CPU overhead to a certain extent

tags.bug: Fixed the number of monster summons not being updated based on upgrades, and the wave number was not accumulated
Fixed an error when obtaining a variant weapon
Fixed a missing crash for plant rewards
and a series of fragmentary problems that are difficult to describe
